value: The high-pressure intake pump must ramp up at a maximum rate of 0.5 bar per minute to prevent membrane telescoping.
The anti-scalant dosing pump must be energized and verified active prior to raw water valve actuation.
During startup, the permeate bypass valve must remain fully open, and the brine reject flow must be logged every 10 minutes.
The main feed breaker must be tripped immediately if catastrophic seal failure occurs.
If permeate conductivity fails to drop below baseline within 20 minutes, immediately execute the shutdown sequence mandated by [OP-SD-001].
Operators must wear nitrile gloves and splash goggles when handling sodium bisulfite
The dosing skid containment bund must be pumped empty within 4 hours of any detected spill
All empty chemical carboys require a triple rinse with permeate water before disposal
condition-based interventions rather than strictly calendar-based overhauls
retention of all water quality data for a period spanning ten years
